text:
lina: Ask the room — what smell instantly teleports you back to childhood? No work talk, just smells. :nose:
alex: Freshly cut grass. Summers, soccer practice, bare feet. instant transport.
maria: Rain on hot pavement (petrichor). Also coffee + toast from Saturday mornings.
joel: Play-Doh. Every time. Kindergarten art table vibes. 😂
sam: Grandma's lavender sachets in her dresser drawers. Smell = memory.
nav: Campfire + burnt marshmallow. Road trips and late-night stories.
ellie: Hospital antiseptic — weirdly comforting, my mum was a nurse so that smell = home.
chris: @lina This is dumb but motor oil from my dad's garage. Used to sit on the floor and watch him work.
karen: :raised_hands: Wood smoke. First cold morning of the year, windows open to chimney smoke.
ben: Freshly baked bread from the bakery on 3rd. Weekends felt official with that smell.
deploy-bot: heads-up: team lunch at 12:30 today! :lunch: (not a smell, but acknowledging)
lina: Love these. We should do a nostalgia-smell diffuser in the office sometime — wood smoke + lavender? :thinking_face:
